segments.title: Station Sign-On and Technical Check
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the cold-open sign-on, troubleshoots streaming software, and laments segment trigger overload before handing off to the news desk.

segments.title: News Desk with Rick: PHP Vulnerabilities, Escaped Kangaroo, Trump Salute, Jared Kushner Hack, Robot Demo
segments.notes: Rick joins as correspondent; covers global PHP flaw patching surge, Tennessee kangaroo escape, Trump saluting empty air, Kushner phone hack revealing $700M transfers, and Unitree H2X Kung Fu robot demonstration.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Harassment Parody, AOL 6.0 Roast, Drone Gun, Bodybuilder Rage Bait, Columbus Day Parade, Space Ghost
segments.notes: Case and Rick review viewer-submitted clips: workplace harassment parody, profane AOL 6.0 satire, personal drone missile gun, steroid physique rage-bait, evolving Columbus Day parade vlog, and Space Ghost interview.

segments.title: Rennerton Rebuild: Valheim Server Launch and Skeleton Mayor Press Conference
segments.notes: Munch (as immortal skeleton Skellomunch) launches Valheim server to rebuild Rennerton, harvests resources, constructs mayor's mansion and press corps, fields hostile citizen questions, bans Crum from candidacy.

segments.title: Raid Outro
segments.notes: Case raids Wolf Den (Vinodd) and directs Patreon members to post-show stream.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opens with Pepito's technical sign-on before Case Blackwell and Rick deliver a news block covering global PHP vulnerability exploits, an escaped Tennessee kangaroo, Trump saluting empty air, Jared Kushner's hacked phone, and a Unitree Kung Fu robot demo. The pair then host Amongst the Web reviewing viral clips including a profane AOL 6.0 parody and a personal drone missile gun. In the final segment, Munch — now an immortal skeleton following his September incineration — launches a Valheim server to rebuild Rennerton from wilderness, constructs a mayor's mansion and press corps, and holds a hostile press conference where he bans Crum from future candidacy.
